seoTitle: How to Issue a Full or Partial Refund in Stripe
metaDescription: Process full or partial refunds in your Stripe dashboard by locating the payment, entering the amount, and confirming the return.
intro: Whether a customer needs a full refund or just a partial one, Stripe makes the process straightforward once you know where to look in the dashboard. This guide covers how to locate a payment, issue a refund, and confirm the money has been returned to your customer.

steps.heading: Locate the original payment
steps.body: Search for the transaction in your Stripe dashboard using the customer name, payment ID, or date.

steps.heading: Select the refund option
steps.body: Open the payment details and choose the refund action to begin the process.

steps.heading: Enter the refund amount
steps.body: Specify whether you want to refund the full amount or just a partial portion of the payment.

steps.heading: Confirm and send the refund
steps.body: Submit the refund so the funds are returned to the customer's original card or bank account.

steps.heading: Confirm the customer received it
steps.body: Check the payment status afterward and follow up with the customer if needed to confirm the refund went through.

faq.question: How long does a Stripe refund take to reach the customer?
faq.answer: Refund timing varies, but it typically takes a few business days for the funds to appear back on the customer's card or account.

faq.question: Can I issue more than one partial refund on the same payment?
faq.answer: Yes, you can issue multiple partial refunds as long as the total doesn't exceed the original payment amount.

faq.question: Does Stripe charge a fee for processing refunds?
faq.answer: Stripe generally doesn't refund its original processing fee, even when you refund the customer's payment, though policies can vary.

faq.question: What if a refund fails to process?
faq.answer: Check the payment's status in your dashboard for error details, and verify the original payment method is still valid for refunds.
